---
name: create-instructions-copilot
description: Use this prompt to generate a new agent instructions file.
agent: instructions-generator-copilot
---

Take the information below and generate a [NAME].instructions.md file for it in .github/instructions directory. Generate an appropriate name for the [NAME] placeholder based on the provided content. Make sure the instructions are clear, concise, and specific and not too long. If no information is provided below, prompt the user to give the necessary details about layer of architecture or coding standard to document. This .md file should have frontmatter with a description property which informs copilot when to use this file.
